articles.title: The $11.2 billion in 2026 funding that killed crypto’s permissionless era
articles.description: Dubai-based crypto lawyer Irina Heaver and her team parsed every crypto deal in the first half of 2026. BlackRock, Goldman, and Persian Gulf sovereigns all wrote checks to regulated firms.

articles.title: Depleted strategic oil reserve nears level that raises concerns about damage to caverns, operations
articles.description: The rapid drawdown of the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve could damage the caverns that store the oil, experts warn.

articles.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030 is ‘mathematically impossible’ says Markus Thielen
articles.description: The trillions required to boost Bitcoin to a price of $1 million per coin is not going to happen by 2030... or perhaps ever, says party pooper Markus Thielen.

articles.title: Trump-Linked World Liberty Gets Conditional Bank Charter for USD1 Stablecoin
articles.description: The proposed World Liberty Trust Company would take over issuance of the USD1 stablecoin from BitGo.

articles.title: Marijuana reform is emerging as a midterm elections issue on both sides of the aisle
articles.description: With November's midterms fast approaching, cannabis reform is an issue. It's popular with voters, but its power to tilt elections remains uncertain.

articles.title: Clarity survives (barely), Strategy sells and the untold story of Mastercard's $1.8 billion deal: Crypto's week in 5 stories
articles.description: Washington kept crypto’s biggest legislative hope alive, Wall Street pushed deeper into digital assets, and a security scare sent billions of dollars of bitcoin moving between wallets.

articles.title: Bitcoin could bottom in October, altcoins are ‘basically dead,’ Swan CEO says
articles.description: Klippsten said Bitcoin could bottom about a year after its previous peak and argued that crypto’s best outcome is to become part of TradFi.

articles.title: Berkshire adds $17 billion to Alphabet stake
articles.description: Google parent Alphabet is now the third largest holding in Berkshire Hathaway's equity portfolio.

articles.title: Between earn-nothing cash, broken long-term bonds, these are the safety trades of 2026 market
articles.description: Investors have flocked to short-term investments like ultra-short bond funds in anticipation of a stock market correction and with long-term bonds broken.

articles.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare

articles.title: How long will software-defined cars last? The auto industry doesn't know yet
articles.description: Cars that run on software offer benefits automakers and many customers say older cars cannot compete with. But some analysts worry the vehicles might not last.

articles.title: Wall Street's private blockchain obsession is a 'race to the bottom,' Ethereum advocate Raman warns

articles.title: Iran rebuffs Trump's claim over Strait of Hormuz amid report of another ship being struck

articles.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%

articles.title: Beijing is said to move to clarify tax rules stoking confusion among China's ultra-wealthy

articles.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval

articles.title: Trump expected to attend White House meeting with crypto CEOs, sources say
articles.description: Those involved in a meeting of CEOs from the worlds of crypto, prediction markets and AI anticipate President Donald Trump will take part in next week's gathering.
